remarks: No single dedicated 'factory license portal' (analogous to Himachal Pradesh's OFRIS) could be found or verified for this UT; the most relevant verified regulatory text is the 2026 Draft OSHWC Rules PDF, which is explicitly presented as superseding the older Dadra and Nagar Haveli Factories Rules, 1971 and the Goa, Daman & Diu Factories Rules, 1985 (as applicable to Daman and Diu) — note it is still a DRAFT (open for objections as of its 20-07-2026 notification) and not yet the final gazetted rule text.

The UT's named single-window portal, investdd.gov.in, could not be reached this session (proxy-level connection refusal and DNS failure both occurred), so its existence is corroborated only indirectly via the NeGD India Stack Local directory entry, not by direct verification of the portal itself.

The UT administers factory-related functions split across the Labour & Employment department (OSH/Factories rules, licensing authority per the draft rules' 'Commissioner-cum-Secretary (Labour)') and the District Industries Centre / Department of Industries (industrial registration, EODB schemes) — both departments' live document-listing pages on ddd.gov.in were verified.

ddd.gov.in's document/service listings are filtered by a single flat 'category' taxonomy (no combined department+type filtering via URL), so older, non-recently-dated documents (e.g. an original scanned Dadra and Nagar Haveli Factories Rules, 1971 gazette PDF) may exist on the site but were not surfaced within the pages checked this session; only the first few pages of the Labour & Employment and District Industries Centre listings were inspected.
